summary: Storage commands explain why they are disabled, distinguish unsupported folder access from workflow locks, and point failed verified backups to readable recovery downloads in the current browser.
warning: Downloads capture saved files only. Unsaved drafts are excluded. Restore, cleanup and storage switching retain their guards. Readable recovery reports omissions and is separate from a verified restore backup. No installed posts or saved revisions are changed.

checklist.schema: No workbench, project, UPID, revision, machine-package or post schemas change.
checklist.events: No execution events or API mutations change. Interface eligibility remains shared with existing storage/workflow guards.
checklist.capabilities: No machine/post capabilities change. Directory picker availability is explained independently of editor state. Backup and readable recovery downloads work without directory access.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No controller generation, audit rules or output formatting changes. Quota diagnostics prioritize current-browser recovery downloads and preservation of site data.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No migration or implicit mutation. Restore/cleanup/location-switch guards remain intact; saved-file backup stays available in open editors. Disabled controls reference visible reasons.
checklist.verification: Storage quota and backup tests cover clear recovery guidance, accessible disabled descriptions and preservation of exact originals. Chromium journeys verify unsupported folder access, locked restore, saved-file backup from an open editor and readable recovery after verified backup fails on retained history. Native TypeScript, production build, lint and shared UI checks pass. Physical machine verification is unchanged.

publicNotes.summary: See why storage recovery commands are unavailable and which download still works.
changes: Folder, backup and restore commands show accessible reasons when disabled.
A failed verified backup points to readable recovery export without requiring another browser or folder access.
publicNotes.compatibility: Projects, installed packages, originals, saved revisions and controller output are unchanged. Restore and cleanup still require the normal safeguards.
publicNotes.action: Open Settings → Storage. Download a backup of saved files; if validation fails, capture readable recovery files below. Keep the download and do not clear site data.
